extDescription.message: Saves a fanfic from the open page as TXT, HTML or EPUB: AO3, Ficbook, FanFiction.net, Fanfics.me and Wattpad.

popupBackground.message: Downloading in the background — the file will appear in Downloads.

statusUpdatedHint.message: The work was updated after you set the status. Choose the status again to hide this.

statusesLink.message: AO3 statuses: save to file or load

statusesCount.message: Works with a status in this browser: $1

statusesEmpty.message: Nothing to save yet: no work has a status.

statusesBadFile.message: This is not a FanBooks Saver statuses file.

statusesHint.message: Statuses live only in this browser. The file is a copy: keep it before reinstalling the extension or load it on another computer. Loading adds statuses from the file; if a work is marked both here and in the file, the newer status stays.

errTabClosed.message: The tab was closed before it loaded

errNotArchive.message: The address is not in the archive list

rateAsk.message: Enjoying FanBooks Saver? A rating in the store helps a lot.

popupRate.message: ★ Like it? Rate it in the Chrome Web Store

runSavedCopy.message: File saved to Downloads. AO3 is unavailable — source: $1.

copyWaybackPartial.message: Wayback Machine copy from $1 (may contain only the first chapter)

stageAo3saver.message: AO3 is unavailable — looking for a copy on ao3saver…

stageWayback.message: Looking for a copy in the Wayback Machine…

stageWait.message: The site asks to wait — continuing in $1 s

errAo3Down.message: AO3 is unavailable right now, and no saved copy of this work was found on ao3saver or in the Wayback Machine. Try again later — status: status.archiveofourown.org.

errLogin.message: This work is only available after logging in to $1.

stageRetry.message: The site didn’t respond — retrying in $1 s

errNetwork.message: Couldn’t reach the site. Check your internet connection and try again.

errRateLimited.message: The site has temporarily limited access. Try again in a few minutes.

errCloudflare.message: The site blocked the request (Cloudflare check). Reload the page and try again.

errNotFound.message: Work not found: it may have been deleted or hidden.

errNoText.message: The site doesn’t show the text of this work.

errLayout.message: Couldn’t recognize the work page: the site may have changed its layout.

errNoChapterText.message: The site doesn’t show the text of chapter $1.

errNoPartText.message: The site doesn’t show the text of part $1.

popupTranslateHint.message: The whole work opens in the tab — press “Translate” in the browser, and the file is saved with the translation, pictures and links.

popupTypeSite.message: Paste a link or type a site and press Tab: $1.

popupPressTab.message: Press Tab to insert the site address.

popupUnsupported.message: This link isn’t from a supported site.

popupNotWork.message: $1: this isn’t a link to a work.

popupWorkOther.message: $1, work $2 — will download in the background, the file will appear in Downloads.

popupWorkOpen.message: $1, work $2 — will open in a new tab for translation.

trPressTranslate.message: Press “Translate” in the browser — saving will start by itself.

trPressTranslateDetail.message: The translate icon is in the address bar, or right-click the page → “Translate”. Already says “Translated” but the text isn’t translated? Click “Show original”, then “Translate” again. × — cancel.

trScrolling.message: Scrolling so the whole work gets translated…
